intro: Niger has been under military rule since the 2023 coup.

chapters.title: Who rules
text: General Abdourahamane Tchiani leads the military government and in 2025 was given a five-year transition. Niger left ECOWAS and joined the Alliance of Sahel States.

chapters.title: Insecurity
text: Armed groups are active in the west and south-east.

keyTerms.meaning: A period before a promised return to civilian rule.
